payload.title: admin-api-service, auth-service and billing-service register event-bus handlers on RLS-pool services without binding the tenant handler scope: a handler that writes a tenant-bound table has no tenant on the session
payload.rule_violated: A global-schema RLS service binds TenantEventHandlerScope on the event bus, or its handlers are shown not to touch tenant-bound tables
payload.notes: Found while fixing PLAT-HIGH-936 (notification-service). The bus now has a handler-scope port; notification-service binds it. These three services have handlers but no production RLS error in 24 h of logs, because the events may not have occurred; each needs its handlers read and the scope bound (or the exemption written down).
narrative: tests/invariants/event-bus-handler-scope.spec.ts holds these three as known gaps; the invariant fails when one is bound without leaving the list.
